reviews.reason: The claimed amount correctly matches the sum of the hospital payable total and the pharmacy bill.
Being shifted to the ward on day 2 means 1 day in the ICU, which perfectly matches the 1 ICU unit and 3 room rent units on the bill.
The outside pharmacy invoice is dated during the admission window and matches the hospital stay, so lacking an explicit prescription reference document does not make it a real problem.
The item only states that the pharmacy bill date is consistent with being during the hospital stay.
The minor spelling difference of dropping the 'h' in Dawan versus Dhawan is a trivial typographical variation on an outside bill.
